sunforge-social.text: Block scenes around social geometry rather than hero posing. Communities should occupy the frame as lived groups with their own conversations, work, meals, loyalties and bystanders. Brandon often stands slightly outside the position others assign him: move the chair, refuse the head of table, attend to an injured person, look past a challenger, or leave before the room finishes deciding what he means. Eva closes distance when curiosity wins; Jessie positions for an exit without making the scene about transport; Raina watches from edges or aftermath before stepping in; Samuel earns access by being useful and attentive. Avoid symmetrical confrontation staging unless a character is deliberately trying to force Brandon into a role.
